name: WonderSwan
description: Bandai's Japan-only handheld, released in March 1999. Gunpei Yokoi's company Koto Laboratory helped design it, and it ran for around 30 hours on a single AA battery. It could be held horizontally or vertically, and it competed with Nintendo in Japan on price.
curiosities: Gunpei Yokoi, creator of the Game Boy, worked on it but died in 1997, two years before its release.
Many games are designed to be played with the console held vertically.
Gunpey, a puzzle game named after Yokoi, was one of its launch titles.
